Fragments.Description: Average of data collected, 51 datapoints. Porcelain Tiles are typically fired at higher temperatures in the manufacturing process when compared to other Ceramic Tiles which could affect the embodied carbon. Possible overlaps between Porcelain Tiles and other general Ceramic should be considered.
Average of data collected, 19 datapoints. This refers to sanitary ceramic products (e.g., wash basins, toilets etc.)
Average of data collected, 81 datapoints. Possible overlaps between Ceramic Tiles and Porcelain Tiles should be considered. Other terms such as Stoneware can also be used to refer to either type.
